content: You give but little when you give of your possessions. It is when you give of yourself that you truly give.
author: Kahlil Gibran
explanation: Material gifts cost only wealth, which can be replenished. But when you give your undivided attention, vulnerability, empathy, and time, you are giving irreplaceable fragments of your finite earthly existence.
practicalInsight: Offer someone your complete, uninterrupted presence today without checking your phone or rushing the dialogue.
reflectionPrompt: Are you substituting material tokens for genuine emotional presence in your most important relationships?
